questions.q: Birlik aylanada P(1; 0) nuqtani α burchakka burganda hosil bo'lgan (x; y) nuqta uchun sin α nimaga teng?
questions.explain: Ta'rifga ko'ra sin α = y, cos α = x.
cos α = 0 bo'lgan α = π/2 + πk nuqtalarda tg α = sin α / cos α mavjud emas.

questions.q: Har qanday α haqiqiy son uchun |sin α| ≤ 1 va |cos α| ≤ 1 bajariladi.
questions.explain: Birlik aylanadagi nuqtalarning x² + y² = 1 bo'lgani uchun |x| ≤ 1, |y| ≤ 1.
sin 0° = 0 bo'lgani uchun ctg 0° = cos 0° / sin 0° aniqlanmagan.

questions.q: sin x = 0 sodda trigonometrik tenglamaning yechimini toping.
questions.explain: Birlik aylanada y = 0 nuqtalar 0 va π da, ya'ni x = πk.

questions.q: sin x = 1 sodda trigonometrik tenglamaning yechimini toping.
questions.explain: y = 1 nuqtaga faqat π/2 + 2πk burchaklar mos keladi.

questions.q: sin x = −1 sodda trigonometrik tenglamaning yechimini toping.
cos x = 0 sodda trigonometrik tenglamaning yechimini toping.
questions.explain: x = 0 koordinata Oy o'qida, ya'ni π/2 + πk burchaklarda.

questions.q: cos x = 1 sodda trigonometrik tenglamaning yechimini toping.
cos x = −1 sodda trigonometrik tenglamaning yechimini toping.
tg x = 0 sodda trigonometrik tenglamaning yechimini toping.
questions.explain: sin x / cos x = 0 ⇔ sin x = 0 ⇔ x = πk.

questions.q: ctg x = 0 sodda trigonometrik tenglamaning yechimini toping.
questions.explain: cos x / sin x = 0 ⇔ cos x = 0 ⇔ x = π/2 + πk.
